refactor: fix semantic-release publishing (#12)

Update semantic-release workflow to use create-github-app-token action
instead of GITHUB_TOKEN to work with GitHub rulesets requiring PRs.

Key changes:
- Add actions/create-github-app-token@v2 step
- Update actions/checkout to use the generated token
- Update permissions to contents: read and id-token: write
- Use app token instead of GITHUB_TOKEN
